commitMessage: DEV-19: Build deterministic development context engine
objective: Create a deterministic development-context engine that combines active phase identity, repository snapshot, repository discovery, project architecture, approved scope, active session state, and relevant repository artifacts into a bounded context object for downstream River Development Agent planning, reasoning, implementation, review, and resume workflows.
architecturalContext: River Development Agent roadmap Generation II
acceptanceCriteria: The context engine resolves the active phase specification using the existing phase-resolution system.
The context engine captures current repository branch, commit, cleanliness, and changed paths using the existing repository abstraction.
The context engine consumes DEV-18 repository discovery rather than performing an independent repository traversal.

The context engine includes project identity, configured key paths, architectural context, approved scope, acceptance criteria, required tests, quality gates, approved commands, repair limits, and approval boundaries from the active specification.
The context engine loads active River Dev session state when present without requiring a session to exist.
The context engine records whether the active session repository context matches the current repository context.
The context engine selects bounded relevant repository entries using deterministic classification and phase-scope rules.
Protected and secret-classified paths are never included as readable context artifacts.
Context output is deterministic when repository state, specification, session state, and timestamp are held constant.
Context output exposes enough identity information for downstream systems to detect stale or mismatched context.
A CLI command produces a readable development-context report.
Context generation is read-only and performs no repository mutations.
Focused tests, River Dev typechecking, and main-project typechecking pass.
